stemMd: A population initially grows rapidly, then slows as food and nesting sites become limiting. Which model best captures the resulting approach to a sustainable limit?

options.label: E
options.textMd: Growth independent of population density at all times

explanationMd: As density rises, limited resources reduce net population growth. Logistic growth models this feedback and an approach to carrying capacity, unlike unrestricted exponential growth.

distractorRationale.a: Slower growth need not mean extinction.
distractorRationale.d: Resource limitation contradicts indefinite exponential increase.
distractorRationale.e: The limiting effects described increase with density.
